claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Parachlorophenol is a membrane-active, cationic amphiphilic biocide that at 2.5 uM over 5 days most plausibly causes non-selective cytotoxicity through physicochemical disruption of lysosomal and plasma membranes rather than through any annotated antiinfective target.
